sections.heading: About the artist:
paragraphs: Denver-based Chroma Lips make music built from layered guitars and synth, with dual male & female vocals over a driving rhythm section. The group takes a DIY approach, writing, recording, and creating artwork from their hand-built home studio. Motivated by a passion for travel and a refusal to settle into the predictable, with the release of chromaZone, have laid the groundwork for a project built to stay in motion.

sections.heading: Chroma Lips debut album:
paragraphs: Transmitting from a universe of texture and motion, a sonic atmosphere of guitars and synthesizers blur into one as the record brings you into a steady, motorik-driven momentum.
Self-produced and recorded, fronting members Harrison Edwards and Violet De Vries fashioned the record in their hand-built DIY studio.
Across ten tracks, chromaZone moves through desert highways, derelict cityscapes, electric rock clubs, and late-night reflection.
